mapper.update: INSERT INTO certification (merge_key, date_of_approval, title, target, government_departments, category) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{dateOfApproval}, #{title}, #{target}, #{governmentDepartments}, #{category}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO company_certification (company_id, certification_id, inserted_at, updated_at, deleted, sync_id) SELECT c.company_id, e.certification_id, now(), now(), false, #{syncId}::uuid FROM company c JOIN certification e ON e.merge_key = #{dto.mergeKey} WHERE c.corporate_number = #{dto.corporateNumber} ON CONFLICT (company_id, certification_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = false, updated_at = now(), sync_id = EXCLUDED.sync_id WHERE company_certification.deleted IS DISTINCT FROM false OR company_certification.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.sync_id
UPDATE company_certification cc SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE cc.deleted = false AND cc.company_id = (SELECT c.company_id FROM company c WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber})

UPDATE company_certification cc SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE cc.deleted = false AND cc.company_id = (SELECT c.company_id FROM company c WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber}) AND cc.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{syncId}::uuid
